title: NANSEN folder assignments
description: Folders (or files) of the data locations matched to an entity by hand, as dev's FolderMatcherDialog did for session folders it could not match: at dataset.assignments.nansen.json in the project. A scan treats each as the entity with the given key, whatever its name, so the entity's record gets its location and files; what lies below it is walked as usual.

dataLocation.description: The data location's identifier in the DSM config.

path.description: The entry relative to the location's root, as a scan lists it: '/' between names, and a '/' at the end of a folder. The same in every root of the location.

entityType.description: The entity type of the entry's level in the location.

key.description: The entity's key: a value for every key column of the entity type (its ancestors' identity, then its own).
